description.value: The Roxy is an independent neighbourhood movie theatre in Victoria's North Park area, screening a mix of new releases, classic films, Studio Ghibli retrospectives, and community events like talent show socials. Its eclectic programming and intimate single-screen format make it a distinctive cultural stop for visitors exploring the city by bike.
